rationale: While the instrument is showing strong relative volume (1.90x) and is trading above both the 9-EMA and VWAP, it is currently testing the resistance level of today's high ($12.28). Given the lack of a catalyst or news to drive a breakout and the fact that the price is extended in its range (86.9%), the risk-to-reward ratio for a long entry at this resistance point is unfavorable. I prefer to wait for a clear breakout above $12.28 or a pullback to the VWAP support level before committing capital.
